region.description: No longer written; documents written before keep it

batchIntervalMs.description: Configured batch interval of the node, in milliseconds

mediaStats.description: Whether the node reports media statistics; absent on documents written before it existed (read as true)

rtcEngine.description: RTC engine of the server; absent on older documents (pion)

mediaNode.description: Media node label of the server; absent when it has none

ip.description: IP of the machine named by mediaNode; only with a label

drainingAt.description: First heartbeat while the server drained

stoppedAt.description: Set by a graceful stop, after the final batch

hosted.description: Rooms whose ROOM_CREATED the server wrote as their host

reconciled.description: Rooms of the server closed by the reconciler
